title: Curlew Collection v1
description: Schema for curlew collection YAML files

variables.description: Collection-level variables. Each value may be a plain string or an object form {from_command|value, sensitive, cache}.

setup.description: Requests to execute before the main requests. Array form: a list of request items. Object form: { retry, items } to apply a shared retry override to every item in this phase.

requests.description: Main requests to execute. Array form: a list of request items. Object form: { retry, items }.

teardown.description: Requests to execute after the main requests. Same array-or-object forms as setup.

rate_limit_rps.description: Global token-bucket rate limit in requests per second, applied across the whole run. 0 = unlimited.

include.description: Other collection files to include. Items are spliced into setup/requests/teardown in order. Variables in this collection form a snapshot the included children inherit; child variable changes never leak back to this collection.

retry.description: Collection-level retry defaults. Overridden by section-level and request-level retry configuration.

output.description: Per-collection output configuration. Overrides project-level output; overridden by CLI flags (precedence: CLI > collection > project > built-in).

config.description: Collection-level config block. Currently holds the faker locale for this collection.

signing.description: Collection-wide default signing, applied to every request item that neither sets its own signing: nor explicitly nulls it.

output.description: Default output configuration. Overridden by collection-level output and CLI flags (precedence: CLI > collection > project > built-in).

section.description: A phase (setup, teardown, or requests) — either an array of requestItems or an object { retry, items }.

requestItem.description: A single request entry in the collection

path.description: Path to an external request YAML file

auth.description: Name of an auth profile declared in curlew.yaml (auth_profiles block) to apply to this request.

required.description: Whether this request is required (stops execution on failure)

variables.description: Request-level variables. Each value may be a plain string or an object form {from_command|value, sensitive, cache}.

extract.description: Extract values from the response using JSONPath

retry.description: Request-level retry override. Takes precedence over section and collection retry configuration.

data_driven.description: Data-driven configuration: run this request once per row in the source dataset.

if.description: CEL boolean guard evaluated before templating. A false result skips this item with reason "if: false". May reference vars.*, env.*, and previous.status / previous.headers / previous.body.

depends_on.description: Names of request items in the same phase that must run before this one. Drives skip propagation in every mode and wave ordering under --parallel. A name matching no item in the phase is a parse error.

signing.description: Per-item signing override. An explicit null (signing: ~) disables an inherited collection-level default for this item; an absent field inherits it.

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, etc.). Optional: defaults to GET, to POST when protocol is graphql, and to WS when protocol is websocket.

body.description: Request body (string or object). Mutually exclusive with body_file and body_binary_file.

body_file.description: Path to a text file whose contents are sent as the request body. Variable placeholders ({{var}}) are interpolated at request time. Content-Type is auto-detected from the file extension; an explicit Content-Type header always wins. Paths are resolved relative to the collection file. Mutually exclusive with body and body_binary_file.

body_binary_file.description: Path to a file whose raw bytes are sent as the request body. No interpolation. Content-Type is auto-detected from the extension (falling back to application/octet-stream); an explicit Content-Type header always wins. Paths are resolved relative to the collection file. Mutually exclusive with body and body_file.

query.description: Query parameters appended to the URL

protocol.description: Protocol adapter. Defaults to http. A ws:// or wss:// URL auto-detects as websocket unless protocol is set explicitly.

graphql.description: GraphQL configuration. Meaningful when protocol is graphql.

websocket.description: WebSocket configuration. Meaningful when protocol is websocket.

status.description: Expected HTTP status code(s) — integer or array of integers.

max_duration_ms.description: Maximum allowed response time in milliseconds

schema.description: Path to a JSON Schema file, relative to the collection file directory. The schema is compiled at parse time and validated against the response body.

cel.description: CEL boolean assertions evaluated against the activation {response, previous, vars, env}.

retry.description: Retry configuration. All fields are optional and inherit from lower-precedence scopes. Precedence: request > section > collection > built-in defaults.

retryOn.description: Conditions that trigger a retry attempt.

doNotRetryOn.description: Conditions that prevent a retry attempt.

variables.description: Variable map. Each value may be a scalar string OR an object form declaring a command-sourced variable.

variableEntry.description: Object-form variable entry. 'from_command' and 'value' are mutually exclusive.

from_command.description: Shell command whose stdout becomes the variable value. Mutually exclusive with 'value'.

sensitive.description: When true, the resolved value is tracked as a secret and redacted from output streams.

cache.description: TTL in seconds for cached command output; 0 disables caching.

dataDriven.description: Data-driven testing configuration: run this request once per row in the source dataset.

source.description: Path to the data file (CSV/JSON/YAML), relative to the collection file.

format.description: Source format; auto-detected from extension when omitted.

config.description: Cross-cutting configuration block. Same shape as the config: block in curlew.yaml (schemas/project-v1.json $defs.config).

locale.description: Faker locale for $faker.* output, e.g. de-DE. Precedence: --locale > collection config.locale > project config.locale > en.

signing.description: Request signing, applied between variable templating and dispatch. An explicit null disables an inherited collection-level default, which is meaningful on a request item.

type.description: Registered signer name. Built-ins: aws-sigv4, oauth1.

params.description: Signer-specific parameters, forwarded verbatim to the signer factory. aws-sigv4: region, service, access_key, secret_key, session_token. oauth1: consumer_key, consumer_secret, token, token_secret, method, realm.

celAssertions.description: CEL boolean assertions. Each entry is either the expression string itself or a single-key mapping { cel: "<expr>" }. A mapping carrying cel: alongside an operator key is rejected by the parser.

graphql.description: GraphQL request configuration. query and query_file are mutually exclusive; that constraint is enforced by the parser, not here.

query_file.description: Path to an external .graphql file, relative to the collection file. Mutually exclusive with query.

fragments.description: Paths to .graphql fragment files, concatenated onto the query.

variables.description: GraphQL operation variables bound to $placeholders in the query.

error_handling.description: Partial-success policy for a 200 response carrying an errors array. Default fail.

websocket.description: WebSocket request configuration. Steps execute sequentially within one connection lifecycle.

websocketStep.description: A single action within a WebSocket request lifecycle. Which keys are meaningful depends on action.

message.description: send: literal JSON object payload. expect: JSONPath assertion map (path to {operator: value}).

message_template.description: send: path to an external template file, loaded at parse time and interpolated at send time.

variables.description: send: step-scoped variables merged in for message_template interpolation.

timeout_ms.description: expect: bound on the wait for a matching message.

any_of.description: expect: alternative JSONPath assertion sets; the first that matches wins.

count.description: expect: number of matching messages to collect. 0 or absent means 1.

websocketReconnect.description: Auto-reconnection on connection-level read failures during an expect step. Assertion failures, expect timeouts, and context cancellation are not retried.

websocketHeartbeat.description: Periodic keepalive. With message unset the adapter sends a protocol ping frame; with message set it sends a data frame and matches the reply against expect.

interval_ms.description: Default 30000. Must be greater than 0 when enabled is true — that conditional is enforced by the parser.

expect.description: JSONPath assertions matched against the pong reply.
